title: Asiad: Eala, Rivera overcome Hong Kong to enter Round of 16

blocks.text: Alex Eala and Shaira Rivera advanced to the Round of 16 after overcoming Hong Kong’s Lai Ching Laam and Liu Kallista in the tennis women’s doubles Round of 32 of the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games at Indoor Court B of the Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Japan on Tuesday.
